title: Synchronize Diagram Pan And Zoom
summary: Fixed all compilation errors in the semio-session crate and got it building and passing all tests. (1) Resolved sqlx/rusqlite libsqlite3-sys conflict by depending on sqlx-core and sqlx-postgres sub-crates directly instead of the umbrella sqlx crate. (2) Updated all sqlx import paths across all source files. (3) Fixed connection query tuple overflow by using Row::get instead of query_as for 17-column queries. (4) Added 29 unit tests covering domain types, command serde, and error HTTP status mapping. All pass.
